correctness.rationale: For N>=2 and a,b,c>0 the age since the last complete Poisson reset is Exp(c). Conditioning on it gives the exact scaled-Beta(1,alpha) binomial-mixture integral for P_k, alpha=c/(a+b), rho=a/(a+b). The adjacent ratio is a positive constant times E_{k,alpha}[U/(1-rho U)]; likelihood-ratio ordering under (1-u)^(alpha-1) makes it strictly decreasing in alpha with boundary limits (N-k)rho/((k+1)(1-rho)) and 0. Hence k<h=ceil((N+1)rho)-1 gives precisely one unit crossing and k>=h gives none. The stationary balance recurrence b(k+1)Delta_k=a(N-k+1)Delta_(k-1)+(c-a-b)P_k implies one-peaked mass sequence, and successive unit crossings are strictly ordered by applying it to Delta_(k+1) at Delta_k=0. At alpha>=1, all adjacent differences are strictly negative. Independently recomputed exact rational stationary mass vectors at N=4,rho=1/2 and several adjacent ratios; the finite checks corroborate but do not prove all parameters.
